name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CHAIRPERSON DIAZ

  VICE CHAIR MACHADO

  COMMISSIONER SOUSA  COMMISSIONER BACOLOD

  COMMISSIONER MANALO

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  SPECIAL PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  Tuesday, August 20, 2019
  Albert O. Little Community Center
  18750 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262
  5:30 p.m.

1.  Call to Order Special Meeting

2.  Roll Call of Commission

3.  Approval of Agenda

4.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Interim Planning Manager prior to the
  commencement of the meeting. Please note that there is a five-minute time limit
  per speaker imposed. Please stay within this time limit.

5.  Commissioner Discussion

  General discussion among Commissioners regarding commercial, residential, and
  industrial development in the City.

6.  Commissioner Comments

7.  Adjournment
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please
contact the Planning Department at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
